MikroTik 2.5in SATA 8GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 8GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6 is a high-performance storage solution specifically designed for MikroTik routers and servers. Featuring a 8GB SATA SSD, this drive provides reliable storage for operating system files, network configurations, and system updates, making it a perfect choice for small to medium-scale network setups. Built with UEFI boot mode, this SSD ensures faster boot times and better compatibility with newer MikroTik devices. It is designed to work seamlessly with PC MikroTik machines as well as supported MikroTik server machines, offering easy integration into various network environments. The drive is pre-installed with RouterOS v7.20, MikroTik's robust operating system, allowing you to manage and optimize your network infrastructure effectively. The SSD supports OS version updates and downgrades, giving users the flexibility to keep their system up-to-date with the latest features or revert to a previous version as required. With the included MikroTik Level 6 license, users gain access to advanced RouterOS functionalities, such as dynamic routing, firewall security, VPN services, and more, making this SSD ideal for businesses and enterprise-level applications that require powerful and customizable network management tools. Additionally, the MikroTik 2.5in SATA 8GB SSD offers technical support and warranty coverage, providing peace of mind and ensuring that users can get assistance whenever needed. Available in multiple capacities—8GB, 16GB, 32GB, 64GB, and 128GB—the SSD allows you to choose the appropriate size based on your network's needs. The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 8GB SSD is a reliable, cost-effective, and scalable solution for powering MikroTik routers and servers, offering excellent performance and flexibility for modern networking tasks.

MikroTik 2.5in SATA 8GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Features


  • 2.5in SATA Solid State Drive
  • UEFI Boot
  • Build with PC Mikrotik Machine
  • Supported Server Mikrotik Machine
  • Capacity Available: 8GB / 16GB / 32GB /64GB/ 128GB
  • OS Version Update and Downgrade Support
  • OS Version v7.20 Pre-Install
  • Technical and Warranty Support
